tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The Secretary shall carry out a program to promote cooperation on energy issues with countries of the Western Hemisphere.

tree.heading: Activities
tree.text: Under the program, the Secretary shall fund activities to work with countries of the Western Hemisphere to—

children.text: increase the production of energy supplies;
assist in the development and transfer of energy supply and efficiency technologies that would have a beneficial impact on world energy markets.

tree.heading: Participation by institutions of higher education
tree.text: To the extent practicable, the Secretary shall carry out the program under this section with the participation of institutions of higher education so as to take advantage of the acceptance of institutions of higher education by countries of the Western Hemisphere as sources of unbiased technical and policy expertise when assisting the Secretary in—

children.text: working with those countries in the development of new policies; and
